entries.title: Coyote vs. Acme
entries.notes:
Coyote vs. Acme — the long-delayed Looney Tunes movie where Wile E. Coyote
sues Acme for the defective products that keep backfiring on him. Live-action
with animated characters, John Cena as the Acme lawyer.

**In theaters Aug 28, 2026.** Not yet on streaming/VOD — notify Peter the
moment it's available for digital rental or on a streaming service.

Chinese donghua. Protagonists delve into people's memories to erase/heal the monsters that live there. Streaming free on YouTube.

entries.title: Little Shrew
entries.notes:
Gentle, quietly magical picture book by Akiko Miyakoshi (Kids Can Press,
2024). Little Shrew is diligent in all parts of his life — a sweet story
about appreciating life's little pleasures.

**Buy for Tuesday** (daughter) — picture book for a ~2-year-old.

entries.title: Tony
entries.notes:
Tony (2026) — A24 biopic about a 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain (Dominic Sessa)
who travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a
restaurant kitchen, setting off the journey that made him a legend.

Released Aug 21, 2026. **94% on Rotten Tomatoes.** In theaters now — watch
for streaming/rental.
